name: A Candle for: Board Meetings (CISO Edition)
description:
**– Palo Alto Oak –**
Smells like hotel breakfast buffet eggs, sanitized dashboards, cologne on a wrinkled suit, morning breath at a 9 a.m., and a feeling of acronyms no one understands, plus a faint whiff of fear.

*Light this when explaining cloud risk with “just one more chart” doesn’t work. Made with love (and a hint of burnout), these candles were crafted by Wiz for every CISO who’s ever patched from their kitchen or whispered “please no zero-days today” into their coffee. We blended the finest scents to cover the chaos. Because if you’re going to secure the cloud, you might as well do it with a candle that smells like succes.*
